test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with the grammatical error.

Mahesh and his workers / will have been worked / on the project / for a long time.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**worked**" in the phrase "**will have been worked.**"
 
• For future perfect continuous tense, the correct form should be "**will have been working**."
 
• The phrase should correctly read as "**Mahesh and his workers will have been working**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mahesh and his workers will have been working on the project for a long time."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "on the project"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "Mahesh and his workers"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "for a long time"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
